description: Snapshot interactive DOM with volatile ref IDs that invalidate after DOM mutations. For complex SPAs (e.g. GitHub dashboards), use `scope` or `query` to reduce tokens. For forms/pagination/sequential loops, ALWAYS use `delta: true` to save 97% tokens. For canvas/WebGL/Figma pages where the DOM has < 5 interactive elements, use `visual: "auto"` to get a numbered screenshot — then use browser_click({ mark: N }) to interact.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

ax_tree.description: Bypass the extension entirely and read raw Chrome Accessibility Tree. Use this if Shadow DOMs hide elements.

delta.description: Diff mode: return ONLY elements that changed since the last browser_map call (added, removed, or modified). Diffs across time — distinct from prune. Cuts prompt tokens by up to 97% on consecutive calls.

force.description: Force a full DOM map rebuild even if loop detection says nothing changed. Bypasses the map skip guard and resets loop strikes.

full.description: Set to true to return a full markdown table (heavier context) instead of the lite list.

limit.description: Maximum number of elements to return.

lite.description: Return a compact, token-optimized interactive element list.

prune.description: Semantic DOM pruning: compress the current snapshot before returning. Drops hidden elements with no interactive descendants and not referenced by any toggle trigger (aria-controls etc.). Replaces SVG icons with [SVG Icon: label] tokens. Distinct from delta:true — delta diffs across time, prune compresses this snapshot once. Combine both for maximum token efficiency.

query.description: Filter returned elements by label or role substring. Useful on dense dashboards.

scope.description: Restrict parsing to a semantic page area to save tokens. Useful on dense dashboards. 'main' is an alias for 'main_content'.

show_overlays.description: Default false. Debug only — draws colored element borders via extension (ugly). The blue edge glow is the standard visual indicator, shown automatically during reading states. Only enable this for debugging element boundaries.

tab_id.description: Read a specific background tab instead of the active one.

visual.description: Set-of-Marks visual grounding. true = always inject numbered badges + return annotated screenshot. "auto" = only activate when DOM interactive count < 5 (canvas/WebGL/Figma pages). After receiving marks, use browser_click({ mark: N }) to interact with numbered elements.

name: browser_map
